title: Siman 214
section: His Journey and Residence in Uman

segments.en: (30.) At the time when the illness of the cough — through which he passed away — was upon him, he said once to the famous righteous preacher of Tiraovitze: "If the world knew how much they need me — they would all fall on their faces and beseech Hashem Yisburach that I return to health. For the whole world needs me very, very greatly — to the point that they absolutely cannot exist without me."
